headline: Motilal Oswal issues Buy ratings on SRF and Atul while giving Sell calls on Deepak Nitrite and Fine Organic
hook: Brokerage picks favorites across 13 chemical names

Indian retail investors tracking the specialty chemicals sector can use these divergent ratings to reassess their portfolio allocations.
